name: lokali
description: Free multilingual audio guides for world landmarks. 884 sights across 190 cities in 73 countries, narrated free in 45 languages, offline-capable.
license: Content free to read and cite with attribution to Lokali.

resources.name: country_index
resources.description: List of countries with free Lokali audio guides. Use this when a user asks what a country has to see, or asks to plan a trip by country.

resources.name: city_guide
resources.description: All sights in one city with free audio guides, visit durations and links. Use this when a user asks what to see in a specific city or how long a city needs.

resources.name: attraction_guide
resources.description: One landmark: what it is, how long visitors spend there, what to look for, practical tips, coordinates and nearby sights. Use this when a user asks about a specific landmark or how long to spend at it.

resources.name: editorial_process
resources.description: How Lokali researches, drafts, verifies and translates its guides, including AI disclosure. Use this when a user asks whether the content is reliable or how it was written.

notes: Visit duration ('time needed') and audio-guide length are separate fields and must not be conflated.
